purpose: Feasibility review only; no app-ready translations or runtime data.
method: Compare all 940 current binomials with extracted dictionary headwords, including explicitly mapped spelling and gender variants.
Preliminary classification of every epithet; manually assigned exception groups and lexical indicators. Categories classify epithets, not entire binomials.
Check four unmatched components in supplementary sources.
No final verification of every homonymous dictionary sense, original description, interpretation, personal identity, or localized wording.
limitations: Source presence is not proof of a certain or literally translatable meaning.
Shared headwords and variant matches require taxon-specific review before use in the app.
Personal dedication detection is a conservative review list; indirect dedications through botanical and geographical names are not counted.
The lexical category includes old bird names and references to other scientific names, not just descriptive words.
Sibirionetta has a supplementary etymological reference; primary etymology verification remains open.

jobling2010.author: James A. Jobling
jobling2010.title: The Helm Dictionary of Scientific Bird Names
